name: kb
description: patterns-kb. The npm half is two workspaces: tools/ (check gates, generators, the driver) and site/ (the Astro + Starlight site, built from docs/ into site/dist/).
//dependencies: Astro 7.3 made Sätteri the default Markdown processor and dropped @astrojs/markdown-remark to an optional peer of astro and @astrojs/starlight, which npm hoists to node_modules/, where they resolve that peer from node_modules/ too. Declared only by site/, it could install to site/node_modules/ and be invisible to them: astro then rejects the site's markdown.processor. Root is the one place a declaration is sure to hoist. Keep the version equal to site/package.json's. ajv is here for the same reason: eslint pulls ajv 6 and npm hoists it to node_modules/, which left tools/'s ajv 8 nested under tools/node_modules/, where the pre-commit hook's extract (it links only the root node_modules) cannot see it. Keep the version equal to tools/package.json's.
//scripts: Every value is one `make` call: make owns every target, so a script here cannot become a second answer to what a target does.
//allowScripts: Every install script is denied, so an install runs no third-party code. esbuild ships its binary as an optional platform package (@esbuild/<os>-<arch>) that installs with no script; its postinstall only re-verifies it. fsevents is a macOS-only optional file watcher that ships prebuilt; its install script is a node-gyp fallback. Add a row here only with the reason the package cannot work without its script.
